ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (dark/black) to high-intensity (light gray/white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region extending from the peduncle to the median notch. High-intensity light gray patches are located at the distal ends of both lobes. A prominent, isolated circular dark pixel cluster is situated within the light gray patch on the left lobe (viewer perspective).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 45 degrees and a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the trailing edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing boundary. Maximum serration amplitude is observed at the distal tips, particularly the right tip which shows extreme vertical irregularity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering sharply to narrow, highly irregular distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast, irregular dark and white pixel clusters on the distal right tip, representing heavy localized surface disruption.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-intensity linear disruptions visible on the light-toned regions of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular texture and pixel-level fragmentation at the right distal tip; distinct circular dark focal spot on the left light patch.
